_about: Supplier energy prices of the FR notebook: HTA 5-index 'sur courbe' supply contract, 2025, excl. VAT. Probably one site's contract: a site's own supplier prices go in its case overrides (tariff.import_price.energy.per_kwh).
battery_export_note: a fixed-price supply contract may not be resold: the battery exports only energy it stored from PV, energy bought from the grid only serves the site (peak shaving). 'any' lets it export anything, for a contract that allows that

energy.note: supplier energy: HPH 104.04, HCH 75.41, HPE 54.92, HCE 47.80 EUR/MWh; pointe hours are priced as HPH

capacity_gc.note: capacity guarantee cost passed through by the supplier: coefficient 0.5983 on winter peak x 1465 EUR/GC / 100 = 8.765 EUR/MWh
